launch: fresh isolated `claude -p` under sandbox-exec, --setting-sources '' --disable-slash-commands, --strict-mcp-config with ONLY the shared graphify MCP server (one graph merged across the pinned repos), --allowedTools mcp__graphify__* and --disallowedTools Bash,Read,Write,Edit,Grep,Glob,...
cache_prefix_only_note: The first-turn cache read is the CLI's static system-prompt and tool-definition prefix, which is byte-identical across sessions on this machine and was warm from unrelated earlier sessions. It carries no case context: this run's own prompt shows up as cache_creation on that same turn, not as a read. So the RETRIEVAL measurement is clean; what is not comparable is the COST column.
cost_comparability_note: Every sibling cross-repo graphify arm ran with prompt caching OFF (cache_read=0, paying full input price: $13.68-$24.30 per case). This run had caching ON, so its $3.73 is a cached price and must NOT be put in the same column as theirs. Re-run with DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING=1 if a like-for-like cost number is needed; the ranked answer does not change.
cache_clean_note: cache_clean means no cache was inherited from an earlier session, which is what the run conditions require -- NOT that the run read no cache at all. In-run cache (the totals above) is expected and comparable. Judged on cache_read at the first assistant turn.
surface_pure_note: Arm surface is Opus 5 with ONLY the graphify knowledge-graph MCP server (query_graph, get_node, get_neighbors, get_community, god_nodes, graph_stats, shortest_path) against a single merged graph. Bash/Read/Grep/Glob/Write/Edit and every other MCP server are excluded by --disallowedTools and --strict-mcp-config, so a filesystem-grep escape was not merely unused but impossible. Any tool outside the graphify allow-list counts as a surface violation.

sandbox.mechanism: sandbox-exec (macOS seatbelt), profile pinned at sandbox.sb
sandbox.gate4_verified_both_ways: before launch, run.sh proved golden.json UNREADABLE and the merged graph.json still READABLE under the same profile. Checking only the first is what let a stale path pass a tilde profile that denied nothing.
sandbox.note: The benchmark tree is denied wholesale and only the repo directories plus cross-repo/_indexes/graphify/merged and _indexes/graphify_mcp are re-allowed, so golden.json, DONOTREADTHISFOLDER/ and every sibling arm's results fail with EPERM. ~/.claude/projects is denied too, so no earlier session transcript - nor this run's own - is readable. cwd was a fresh empty directory, no settings sources were loaded and slash commands were disabled, so no CLAUDE.md, skills, plugins or hooks applied; auto-memory is unreadable under the sandbox.

prompt_caching: default (in-run caching allowed by this case's run conditions)

index.build: per-repo `graphify extract <repo> --code-only --no-cluster`, then `graphify merge-graphs` into one cross-repo graph (shared across every cross-repo case, built once)
index.index_repo_gap_note: The run_prompt names 15 repositories; the merged graph contains nodes for only 14. `router` was never extracted (no _indexes/graphify/router directory, zero nodes with repo=router), so any router file in gold is unreachable on this surface. Recall is capped by the index, not by the model.
